detail.longDescription: MIT professor Paris Smaragdis wants machines to hear with superhuman precision. His group works on sound source separation, signal processing that drops fixed sampling rates and frame sizes, and folding large language models into speech recognition. The aim is systems that pinpoint a traffic accident from tyre squeals or spot a failing drill in rock. https:// news.mit.edu/2026/making-machi nes-that-can-listen-paris-smaragdis-1028 # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AIresearch
